description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various news sources, divided into 17 categories. The chart is labeled with the name of each news source and its corresponding percentage. The largest slice, "Drudge Report", is blue and accounts for approximately 14% of the total, while the second-largest slice, "Other", is gray and represents around 13%. The remaining slices are distributed among various news sources, including "The Daily Caller" (8%, red), "The Huffington Post" (8%, orange), "NPR" (7%, green), "Vox" (6%, purple), "The Guardian" (5%, pink), "BBC" (5%, brown), "RT" (4%, dark gray), and several others, including "Daily Kos", "National Review", "Daily Mail", "Red State", "Fox News", "CNN", "PoliticusUSA", and "Shareblue", each representing 3%. The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown inside each slice. The slices are arranged in a seemingly random order, with no apparent visual emphasis on any particular category.
